list.title: Attendance
list.subtitle: Start a check-in and project a QR code on the big screen; students scan it in the mini-program or enter the 6-digit code to check in.

empty.none: No check-ins yet — start one top-right

form.offeringPlaceholder: Pick an offering to load sessions and the term report
form.offeringHelper: Leave unset for a standalone check-in (e.g. class meeting) — only scans are counted.
form.sessionPlaceholder: Pick the session for this class
form.sessionHelper: With a session selected, this check-in counts toward the offering's term attendance.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: Required when no offering is set; auto-generated otherwise

validation.lateNonNeg: Late threshold must be a non-negative integer (minutes)
validation.durationNonNeg: Duration must be a non-negative integer (minutes); 0 means manual close
validation.titleRequired: A title is required when no offering is selected

detail.elapsed: Check-in time elapsed; scans will be rejected
detail.hint: Students open the mini-program Check-in Center to scan, or enter the 6-digit code above.

modal.hint: Later scans by this student won't override this correction (scans only apply on first check-in).

warning.noRosterSubtitle: The offering's teaching class has no student records (admin-class members) configured, so absences can't be counted.

report.title: Attendance report
report.subtitle: Pick an offering to view the whole term's check-ins at once (only check-ins linked to that offering/session are counted).
report.noSelection: Pick an offering to view the term's attendance.

table.title: Term check-in matrix
table.description: Rows = students, columns = check-ins, last column = four-status subtotals

warning.noCheckinsSubtitle: Check-ins appear here once started with this offering (or its session) selected.
warning.emptyRosterSubtitle: The offering's teaching class has no student records (admin-class members) configured, so absences can't be counted.
